## Welcome to Orchard Notes

This wiki keeps every page in a signed, verifiable history. Anyone who may read can see what changed,
when, and who proposed and accepted it.

## Reading

Pages link to each other with double brackets, like [[Help]]. A link to a page that does not exist yet
is shown differently: it is an invitation to write it.

## Changing a page

A change is proposed, reviewed, and accepted. Until it is accepted it is *held for review*; once
accepted it is *signed into the history* by the wiki service on behalf of the proposer and the acceptor.

## Trust

The wiki checks its own history and says one of three things about it: *Verified*, *Verification
failed*, or *Could not be checked now*. It never claims more than it checked.
